name: Jyn Erso's blaster
description: Jyn Erso's blaster was an A-180 blaster pistol used by Jyn Erso. An extremely versatile weapon, it had multiple configurations for blaster pistol, blaster rifle or sniper rifle. Formerly owned by Rebel Cassian Andor, it became Jyn's weapon of choice when she stole it from Andor's bag and kept it up until her death during the Battle of Scarif.
